latest.headline: Chips bounce about 5% pre-market after SOX's worst day since 2020
latest.tldr: SOX fell 12.25% to 9,011 Thursday and MU fell 17.5% to $656.39, and Asia sold off again overnight, but US chips are bouncing pre-market: SMH and SOXX are up about 5%, MU is about $703–$710 (+7–8%), and Nasdaq 100 futures are up about 1.5% even after a hot jobs report (+165K) pushed yields higher.
